title: Book Two · Chapter 80: Back Through the Gate
story:
The summer holiday ends. Ronan is ten as he walks through the school gate with Leo and Jun. His new brown shoes make soft sounds on the path.

Their room is in another part of the same school. Miss Wu still meets the children for reading activities. The borrowing corner is by a wider wall now. There is more space near the table.

Ronan looks for the train book. It lies flat on a low shelf. The old arrow label has a bent corner, but he can still read it.

Mei arrives with a new drawing book. Jun asks to see the cover. She lets him look, then takes it to her seat. Leo has a message about a new date for his reading room. The room is ready again.

Ronan opens the new book on his desk. Some pages look familiar. Others have longer lines. He feels worried again at those longer lines.

Leo is already reading the first page. Ronan lifts his own book higher. For a moment, he tries to read as fast as Leo.

Then Miss Wu asks everyone to look at a notice. It tells the children the new times for the borrowing corner. The first time is after lunch, not before lessons.

Ronan reads it twice. Jun asks about the morning.

“Not this term,” Ronan says. He points to the line.

Miss Wu asks him to read the time aloud. He does. His voice is clear. He does not rush the last word.

Later, the class has number work and a new seat plan. Ronan sits near the window. Jun is two rows away. Leo can see both of them from his desk. To talk, one boy needs to turn around.

At lunch, they meet outside. Jun brings the cloth ball. It is dry now, with a faint dark mark from the summer rain.

“New room, old ball,” he says.

“And old arms,” Leo says.

Ronan stretches his hands. “Mine are ten.”

“They were nine for a long time,” Jun says.

After school, Ronan brings the new book home. He shows Mum the notice first. Then he talks about the longer pages. She reads the borrowing time and asks him to put it in his folder.

Then he opens to the first story. He can read the opening part. At the next part, he stops. He looks again. Who is doing the action in this line?

Mum begins her work beside him. He asks about one word. She checks it with him. They are both unsure. He marks it lightly for Miss Wu. He can ask his question in the next reading lesson.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

term＝学期；notice＝通知；same＝相同的。

## 理解问题

1. 新学期有哪些延续，哪些变化？
2. Ronan怎样应对新书上的难处？

## 读句子

**He / marks it lightly / for Miss Wu.** 他／轻轻做记号／准备问Miss Wu。
